content:
Elaine: Quick postmortem follow-up: need to lock customer-facing summary and agree publish flow + who owns the recurrence metric.

Sam: Proposed flow: Eng verifies tech accuracy -> CS drafts tone -> Legal reviews -> Ops publishes. 48h SLA for approvals?

Priyaa: I can draft status blurb + two DM templates (redacted/named). Need impacted account IDs. ETA 3h.

Matt (Legal): Send the RCA summary + redaction list. Legal prefers "RCA provided on request" phrasing; we'll review in 24h if complete.

Jordan (Ops): Added action items to tracker: https://docs.internal/rw/incidents/INC-2105/actions. No owners yet on recurrence dashboard task.

ops-bot: Reminder set — customer-note publish due 2075013145 (48h). React to claim.

Sam: I'll own remediation task #3 (connection pool tweak). Assigning now.

Priyaa: Draft status blurb:

"We experienced elevated API latency for a subset of requests between 2026-03-22 11:08 UTC and 2026-03-22 11:54 UTC due to concurrent autoscaling decisions under constrained capacity. We deployed a mitigation and are monitoring. A detailed RCA will be provided to impacted customers upon request."

Matt (Legal): Edit suggestion: replace "concurrent autoscaling decisions" -> "concurrent autoscale decisions under constrained capacity"; OK on "RCA provided..." Good after redaction list.

Elaine: Add "recurrence risk" column to tracker (low/medium/high) and a weekly "repeat-incident index" on the SRE dashboard. Jordan, can you wire a widget showing trend + top recurring causes?

Jordan (Ops): Yep. ETA 48h to add widget and weekly digest. Will auto-compute recurrence risk from last 90d.

Sam: Who publishes the status page? Ops after Legal sign-off?

Jordan (Ops): Correct. Ops publishes after Legal approves; Ops will notify CS to send DMs.

Priyaa: I'll post DM templates to the tracker with placeholders. Will not send without Legal greenlight and redaction proof.

Matt (Legal): I can review DMs in 12-18h once they include redaction notes and RCA summary. Flag any PII explicitly.

ops-bot: Owners assigned and deadlines saved. :white_check_mark:

Priyaa: Final draft posted: https://docs.internal/rw/incidents/INC-2105/customer-note-v1 — please review by 2075013045.

Sam: Reviewed, :+1:

Elaine: Thanks. Closing loop: Priyaa (customer comms + DMs), Sam (remediation), Jordan (ops publish + dashboard), Matt (legal). Jordan to surface repeat-index at next retro.

Jordan (Ops): Will include in retro agenda.

Priyaa: Preparing to send DMs after ops push in T+10m (pending Legal).
